2607.01305.title: Generative AI and Federated Learning for Intrusion Detection Systems: A Survey
2607.01305.paper_summary: Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are essential for monitoring network traffic and identifying malicious activities in modern cyber-physical, Internet of Things (IoT), enterprise, and distributed network environments. However, developing reliable IDS models remains challenging because attack behaviors evolve over time, realistic datasets are difficult to obtain, traffic records may be incomplete, attack classes are often imbalanced, and privacy constraints limit centralized data collection. Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence (AI) and Federated Learning (FL) provide new opportunities to address these limitations. Generative models can support anomaly detection, synthetic traffic generation, data augmentation, data imputation, adversarial traffic generation, and IDS alert explanation. FL enables distributed IDS training without directly sharing local network traffic, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive and geographically distributed environments. This survey provides a structured review of generative AI and FL techniques for IDS. We first summarize representative IDS research directions, including adversarial machine learning, anomaly-based detection, IoT-oriented IDS, explainable IDS, and benchmark datasets. We then categorize generative AI applications in IDS according to model families and task objectives, covering autoencoder-based models, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), diffusion models, and Large Language Models (LLMs). Finally, we review emerging studies that integrate generative AI with FL-based IDS and discuss open challenges, including synthetic data quality, realistic traffic generation, dual-use adversarial risks, non-IID client distributions, communication-efficient model sharing, federated IDS benchmarking, and domain-specific LLMs for network security.
2607.01305.paper_summary_zh: 入侵檢測系統（IDS）對於監控網絡流量和識別現代網絡物理、物聯網（IoT）、企業及分散式網絡環境中的惡意活動至關重要。<lb/>然而，開發可靠的IDS模型仍然具有挑戰性，因為攻擊行為隨時間演變，現實數據集難以獲得，流量記錄可能不完整，攻擊類別常常不平衡，且隱私限制限制了集中數據收集。<lb/>最近在生成人工智慧（AI）和聯邦學習（FL）方面的進展為解決這些限制提供了新的機會。<lb/>生成模型可以支持異常檢測、合成流量生成、數據增強、數據插補、對抗性流量生成和IDS警報解釋。<lb/>FL使得分散式IDS訓練在不直接共享本地網絡流量的情況下進行，這使其適合於隱私敏感和地理分散的環境。<lb/>本調查提供了生成AI和FL技術在IDS中的結構化回顧。<lb/>我們首先總結了代表性的IDS研究方向，包括對抗性機器學習、基於異常的檢測、面向IoT的IDS、可解釋的IDS和基準數據集。<lb/>然後，我們根據模型系列和任務目標對生成AI在IDS中的應用進行分類，涵蓋基於自編碼器的模型、生成對抗網絡（GAN）、擴散模型和大型語言模型（LLM）。<lb/>最後，我們回顧了將生成AI與基於FL的IDS整合的最新研究，並討論了開放挑戰，包括合成數據質量、現實流量生成、雙重用途對抗風險、非獨立同分佈的客戶端分佈、通信高效的模型共享、聯邦IDS基準測試，以及針對網絡安全的領域特定LLM。
